prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1170; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following side impact collision at intersection. Insured reports other vehicle entered intersection against signal. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles on file from scene. Claimant represented by counsel; all contact to go through attorney's office.

Entry 2: Attorney's office acknowledged representation and submitted letter of representation. Claimant reports concussion symptoms including headache, dizziness and light sensitivity. Medical records request sent to treating provider. Recorded statement from insured obtained and consistent with initial report.

Entry 3: Liability review in progress. Witness statement from nearby pedestrian indicates the claimant's vehicle had the green signal. Traffic camera footage requested from municipal office. Reserve adjusted to reflect bodily injury exposure pending medical documentation.

Entry 4: Received medical summary from claimant's neurologist confirming concussion diagnosis and recommended period of reduced activity. Attorney requested a settlement package including medical bills and wage loss documentation. Requested itemized bills and employer verification of missed work.

Entry 5: Traffic camera footage reviewed and shows other vehicle's signal was red at time of impact. Liability assessment updated to favor claimant. Supervisor notified of bodily injury component. Settlement evaluation scheduled once treatment status is confirmed by attorney's office.
